## MidnightSupplyCollateralTakeBorrowAction interface

Metadata for a Midnight bundle that supplies collateral and borrows from fixed-rate offers.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export interface MidnightSupplyCollateralTakeBorrowAction extends BaseAction<"midnightSupplyCollateralTakeBorrow", {
    readonly market: Hex;
    readonly collateralAssets: bigint;
    readonly loanAssets: bigint;
    readonly maxUnits: bigint;
    readonly taker: Address;
    readonly receiver: Address;
    readonly collateralSupplies: number;
    readonly takeableOffers: number;
    readonly deadline: bigint;
}>
```
